title: Review export's publish rename fails outright on a Windows sharing error, failing the Windows gate
outcome: scripts/export-review-attempt.mjs publishes its staging directory with a single fs.rename. On Windows a transient sharing error (EPERM, EACCES, EBUSY) from another process's handle on a just-written file fails the export and any gate running its tests. The rename waits within a bounded budget on Windows for those codes only, any other error or platform fails at once, the first error is reported past the budget, staging cleanup and the identical-export path are unchanged, and deterministic tests with an injected rename pin each case. Evidence: Windows B FULL test-53c2fc1c on ae0b5d38, tree 01312f45, two tests EPERM at export-review-attempt.mjs:153, the first two tests of the fingerprint-tests stage; probe termal-n6d-rename-probe-1, 3000 cycles, zero failures, so the holder is not identified.
acceptance: Review export's publish rename fails outright on a Windows sharing error, failing the Windows gate is done
disposal_reason: Duplicate I filed before finding the existing item for the same EPERM rename; its evidence is recorded there.
